featured_projects.name: Hybrid-Quantum-Neural-Network-for-binary-classification
featured_projects.description: Final project for the university course 'Quantum Computer Programming', held in the academic year 2022/2023. The purpose of this project is to investigate the structure of a hybrid neural network. To do this, I made use of the 'qiskit' library, which allows useful tools for constructing a classical-quantum neural network.

featured_projects.name: Traffic-lights-recognition
featured_projects.description: Final project for the postgraduate course 'School in AI: Deep learning, Vision and Language for industry', held in the year 2022.The basic idea of this project  is to build a model emulating the behaviour of an autonomous driving car in the management of the action to be taken upon recognition of a traffic light.

featured_projects.description: Final project for the university course 'Neural Computing', held in the academic year 2022/2023.The purpose of this work is to build an architecture of a neural network that can learn to correctly recognize and classify the family to which a butterfly belongs.
